items.translation: 为内存邻接图向量索引创建的默认索引类型是层次可导航小世界（HNSW）。

items.source:
The default type of index created for a Neighbor Partition vector index is
Inverted File Flat (IVF) vector index. The IVF index is a technique designed to
enhance search efficiency by narrowing the search area through the use of
neighbor partitions or clusters.
items.translation: 为邻居分区向量索引创建的默认索引类型是倒排文件扁平（IVF）向量索引。IVF 索引是一种旨在通过使用邻居分区或聚类来缩小搜索范围，从而提高搜索效率的技术。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
